name: socialweb-computer
description: socialweb-computer: one multi-call binary whose subcommand tree is the stack

host-backend.description: Placement backend for long-lived host processes: systemd-user (installs) or proc (dev, tests). Required: no default, never probed

instance.description: Application instance id (dev: derived from the worktree when unset)

state-dir.description: State root; resolved by install or dev, no default here

instance-dir.description: State directory of one application instance (the dev core reads its instance.json there)

kcp-base-workspace.description: Workspace every role addresses its objects under

asset-cache.description: Extraction root of embedded assets (dev: the per-user $XDG_CACHE_HOME/socialweb-computer/runtime when unset)

asset-gc-window.description: dev gc: an asset dir used within this window is kept (Go duration)

profile.description: Dev profile: quick (kine on sqlite + one kcp slot), prodlike (the gateway shape: a postgres unit, one kine per kcp slot on it, blue/green slots a and b behind the front) or market-network (a quick-shaped instance whose MarketNetwork root object runs the shared atproto services and composes child applications, each with its own kcp). run bidder: the MarketBidder profile, prod-qr (QR sign-in into the handle's real account, no PDS), market-network (the bidder's own account on the market network's PDS; needs --network) or dev-local (a local repo, the ephemeral-PDS mode)

bidders.description: dev up --profile market-network: how many MarketBidder child applications the network composes (bidder-1 .. bidder-N), each with its own kcp

with-gateway.description: dev up --profile market-network: also compose a Gateway child application with its own kcp

app-values.description: dev up --profile market-network: a YAML file merged over the built-in market-network defaults (keys bidder and gateway: the NetworkApp fields every bidder or the gateway gets, e.g. bidder.firecracker)

network-timeout.description: How long dev up waits for the MarketNetwork and every child application to report Ready, and how long install bidder gives the guest image download; a third of it, at least 30s, is the budget install bidder gives the search of the release base for that image, and install bidder refuses a value under 30s (Go duration)

parent.description: dev up: the dev host instance (dev host; dev-host by default there) whose kcp holds this instance's bootstrap units as HostProcess objects in root:dev:<instance>, placed by the parent's supervisor; unset runs the instance under its own devsup

postgres-root.description: dev up: absolute root of the extracted postgres asset tree (versions.json postgres) that runs kcp's store in prodlike and every Postgres object (dev build: explicit, never PATH; a release build extracts its embedded postgres)

stand-ins.description: dev up: a JSON file naming the units to place instead of a profile's bootstrap layer, in order ([{role, exec, env, listens}]); the instance then has no kcp (tests place stand-ins this way)

kcp-path.description: Absolute path of the kcp release executable (dev build: explicit, never PATH; units roll kcp: the target asset, unset keeps the current one)

kine-path.description: Absolute path of the kine executable (dev build: explicit, never PATH; units roll kcp: the target asset, unset keeps the current one)

bao-path.description: Absolute path of the OpenBao bao executable an OpenBaoServer with asset bao runs (dev build: explicit, never PATH, optional; a release build extracts its embedded bao)

openbao-plugin-dir.description: Directory holding the OpenBao plugin executables (openbao-plugin-auth-sshsig) an OpenBaoServer's spec.plugins names (dev build: explicit, never PATH, optional; a release build extracts its embedded plugins)

openbao-addr.description: dev up: URL of the OpenBao server the core provisions OpenBao namespaces in and issues component serving certificates from (unset: components serve plain HTTP)

openbao-token-file.description: dev up: absolute path of the file holding the token for openbao-addr

ready-timeout.description: How long dev up waits for kcp /readyz, and how long install bidder waits for the same before it gives up and records a refused bring-up step. The installed core is given it as its ready budget, and the installed unit's start timeout and watchdog are this plus six minutes, so a large value means a long start timeout (Go duration)

owner.description: internal apiserver-front: the application instance (or cluster) whose front this is

kcp-front-address.description: Listen address of kcp's L4 front: dev and bidders pass 127.0.0.1:0 (the port is read back); only the gateway's prod config.json sets 127.0.0.1:6443

front-control.description: internal apiserver-front: the control socket the core sets the backend through (under 108 bytes)

front-state.description: internal apiserver-front: the file holding the chosen backend across front restarts

front-fd-store.description: internal apiserver-front: hand the listening socket to the service manager's fd store (NOTIFY_SOCKET) and take it back from LISTEN_FDS

keep-state.description: dev down: keep the instance state directory

fg.description: dev up: keep the instance bound to this terminal; devsup dies with dev up and Ctrl-C is dev down

binary.description: dev restart core and upgrade: absolute path of the socialweb-computer executable to run next (dev restart: this executable when unset)

tail.description: dev logs: print only the last N lines (0 prints the whole log)

state.description: internal devsup: the supervisor state directory

socket.description: internal devsup: the unix socket path (under 108 bytes); internal iroh-dial: the unix socket the iroh dialer listens on (under 108 bytes)

die-with.description: internal devsup and dev up: stop every unit and exit when this pid exits (0 = never; a test passes its own pid)

clusterprovider-advertise-address.description: Address tenant nodes dial for the cluster control plane

clusterprovider-audit-policy.description: Audit policy file for tenant apiservers

clusterprovider-datastore-has-row.description: The tenant datastore already holds rows (skip the fresh-store check)

clusterprovider-node-agent.description: Path of the node agent executable

gateway-cluster-state-dir.description: Directory of the cluster data dirs the gateway reads to issue and check kubeconfig client certificates

gateway-kcp-public-ca-file.description: PEM file of the CA the kubeconfig carries for its public server (unset when the server has a public certificate)

kubectl.description: Path of kubectl (replaced by kcpapply, M1-HOST-INVENTORY)

set.description: apply, manifests render: the manifest sets, comma-separated, in order (manifests list names them)

values.description: apply, manifests render: a YAML or JSON file of typed values keyed by set name, decoded strictly

dry-run.description: apply: server-side dry run; reports every field whose manager would change and persists nothing. install: print the computed step list and change nothing

phase.description: apply, manifests render: only these phases of each set, comma-separated names or first..last ranges in set order

wait-timeout.description: apply: how long each typed wait may take (Go duration)

handle.description: install bidder: the atproto handle(s) of the bidder instances, comma-separated; a re-run with another handle adds that instance. internal vm: the one bidder instance whose VMs these are. units roll kcp: the one bidder handle whose kcp restarts (unset: the gateway). dev up: makes the instance a bidder application instance whose core runs the ComputeVM controller for this handle. run bidder: the bidder's atproto handle, which also owns its ComputeVMs (in a market network: default <name>.bob.test)

vm-host-backend.description: dev up --handle, dev up --profile market-network and run bidder: the placement backend of the VM units (systemd-user | proc); default the instance's own (proc). systemd-user places them in the account's user manager, which enforces their cgroup limits

vm-runtime-dir.description: internal vm and dev up --handle: the account's runtime dir; each VM's API socket lives under <dir>/swvm

guest-image-source.description: internal vm, dev up --handle, dev up --profile market-network, run bidder and install bidder (written to config.json): file:// or https:// base the pinned guest image (vmlinux, rootfs.ext4, image.json) is fetched from once and verified by sha256; run bidder without one downloads the image of its own build from guest-image-release-base instead, unless the installed bidder's own store already holds the pinned image and verifies, in which case no artifact is asked

guest-image-release-base.description: The base the published guest image is searched under by run bidder and by install bidder when neither --guest-image-source nor a stored source names one; install bidder refuses an empty base, when nothing else names an image, rather than installing a bidder that can provision nothing

vm-stop-grace.description: internal vm, dev up --handle and run bidder: how long a stop waits after SendCtrlAltDel before SIGKILL (Go duration; x86_64 only, arm64 kills at once); unset, the vmStop.graceSeconds measured into internal/versions/versions.json

userns-stage-path.description: Absolute path of swc-userns-stage (dev build: explicit, never PATH)

pasta-path.description: Absolute path of the pinned pasta (dev build: explicit, never PATH)

vmexec-path.description: Absolute path of socialweb-vmexec (dev build: explicit, never PATH)

firecracker-path.description: Absolute path of the pinned firecracker (dev build: explicit, never PATH)

account.description: install/uninstall: the system account (socialweb for a gateway, swc-bidder for bidders when unset)

vm-slots.description: install bidder: VM slots of 65536 subordinate ids reserved in /etc/subuid and /etc/subgid

adopt-account.description: install: take over an existing account no install record names (never needed for an account install created)

purge.description: uninstall: also remove the state dir (vault, kcp store, keys) and the account install created

root.description: install/uninstall: a staged host: the host files (/etc, the linger file, the install record) live under this directory, the state dir is used as given, the account is the invoking user and the units run in the invoking user's own manager (a proof run, no root needed)

force.description: uninstall: proceed while VM units are active (each stopped VM becomes Lost)

sha256.description: upgrade: the published sha256 of --binary; a mismatch is refused

allow-dev-binary.description: install/upgrade: accept a dev build (version says "dev build, not reproducible"); for dev and test runs only, never prod

planned-outage.description: units roll kcp: stop the old slot before the new one starts (the only path for a kcp pair without a storage-compatible kcpCompat record)

store-backup-keep.description: units roll kcp, dev roll kcp: keep at most this many kcp store backups; older ones are removed after a new backup is written and checked

store-backup-keep-days.description: units roll kcp, dev roll kcp: remove kcp store backups older than this many days after a new backup is written and checked (the newest is always kept)

unit-prefix.description: install, units roll kcp, serve gateway kcp: the unit name prefix of the installed application (a test placement; socialweb- when unset)

tls-front-address.description: serve gateway kcp: listen address of the TLS front in front of the gateway's XRPC listener (an edge entry point; port 0 is read back into the Gateway status)

cert-front-address.description: serve gateway kcp: listen address of the client certificate front (an edge entry point; port 0 is read back into the Gateway status)

tls-cert-file.description: serve gateway kcp: the TLS front's certificate (with tls-key-file; unset, a self-signed one under <state>/tls)

tls-key-file.description: serve gateway kcp: the TLS front's key (with tls-cert-file)

bidder-policy.description: run bidder: the policy that gates which RFPs the bidder answers (MarketBidder spec.policy), for an installed bidder whose unit passes no hono-bidder options; a --policy after -- wins. Unset: the profile default (open). Set it in config.json for every prod bidder

bidder-policy-args.description: run bidder: JSON arguments of bidder-policy (the hono-bidder policy-args option); a --policy-args after -- wins

bidder-options.description: run bidder: hono-bidder options, written as after -- (for example "--bid-ttl-sec 1800 --offering-refresh-sec 60"), each an options entry of market-bidder in deploy/apps/option-map.yaml; they become MarketBidder spec.options and so the bidder component's argv. Set it in config.json of an installed bidder; an option after -- wins. Values are split on spaces: a value with a space goes in its own key (bidder-policy-args)

gateway-spec-file.description: serve gateway kcp: a YAML GatewaySpec (network, bidderDids, options of the socialweb-computer-k8s web app, marketNetwork values, webAppFront) the Gateway root object is applied with; its profile is gateway-profile, and the PLC, the web app's gateway-audience and kcp-public-host default to SOCIALWEB_GATEWAY_PLC_URL, SOCIALWEB_GATEWAY_AUDIENCES and SOCIALWEB_GATEWAY_KCP_PUBLIC_HOST; webAppFront, the edge entry point caddy proxies to, defaults to 127.0.0.1:8788 in profile prod and 127.0.0.1:0 otherwise

gateway-profile.description: serve gateway kcp: the profile of the Gateway root object (prod or market-network)

bootstrap-cluster.description: serve gateway kcp: create this cluster (with its account and home workspaces) before the members start; unset creates none

bootstrap-account-did.description: serve gateway kcp: the account DID of bootstrap-cluster (did:web:example.com when unset)

private-hostname.description: internal ns-exec: the UTS hostname the command runs under, in its own user+UTS+mount namespace

bind.description: internal ns-exec: comma-separated <source>:<target> directories bind-mounted in the command's mount namespace (a target that does not exist is skipped)

inside.description: internal ns-exec: the second stage, already inside the namespaces unshare made

cluster-state-dir.description: units roll cluster|link: the cluster provider's state dir, holding each cluster's controlplane.json

k3s-path.description: Absolute path of the k3s executable (serve gateway kcp in a dev build: every tenant cluster's k3s, never PATH; a release build runs its embedded k3s; units roll cluster: the k3s the new slot runs, unset keeps the one the active slot runs)

dumbpipe-path.description: units roll link: the dumbpipe executable the replacement listener runs (unset: the one the link runs); run request, dev up and run gateway ssh in a dev build: the dumbpipe executable that reaches guests over their iroh ticket (a release build runs its embedded dumbpipe); internal iroh-dial: the dumbpipe it runs per connection

service.description: units roll link: the link to replace, apiserver or openbao

idle-bound.description: units roll cluster: how long a swap waits for no non-kube-system pod Running on a market node before it proceeds anyway (Go duration)

network.description: run request and run bidder: the market network instance (dev up --profile market-network) whose MarketNetwork hosts this invocation or bidder as a child application; unset, a requester invocation is a standalone instance under <state-dir>/requests

market-network-file.description: run bidder --profile market-network without --network (an installed bidder account joining a market network over the atproto market protocol only): a JSON file holding the MarketNetwork status (`dev status --instance <n> | jq .network.status`): its network value and bidderPdsUrl. The CA bundle it names must be readable by the bidder account

name.description: run request: the invocation's name, a DNS label (default req-<UTC time>); release and resume take it as their argument. run bidder --network: the bidder's application name in the market network, a DNS label (default from the handle)

secrets.description: run request: a secrets bundle file ([{"path": "/abs/path", "value": ...}]); it is written only into the invocation's own OpenBao, the guest fetches it at boot and it never enters a kcp object

hold.description: run request, resume: keep the contract held when this process ends; its kcp stops and run request release|resume <name> starts it again from its state dir

exec.description: run request, resume: run this program over ssh on the guest (StrictHostKeyChecking=yes against the host keys the guest reported) instead of an interactive session

skip-ssh.description: run request, resume: do not open an ssh session once the guest is on the network

contract-timeout.description: run request: how long the CLI waits for the contract to reach the guest's onNetwork and host keys, and for a release (Go duration)
